corrections.text: The article says the permission-modes documentation applied the default "only on Pro, Max, and Team plans" on earlier versions, without naming the version, and attributes "every plan and provider" to 2.1.284. The documentation itself states that auto mode is the built-in starting mode for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions "with Claude Code v2.1.283 or later", while the changelog assigns "on every plan and provider" to 2.1.284 (September 28) and lists only third-party-provider and telemetry-off sessions under 2.1.283 (September 25). The two sources differ on the version.

The article says the Pro, Max and Team default "began on August 14, according to Simon Willison." Willison's August 8 post only announces it as a planned start ("starting on August 14th") and refers to "most Claude Code plans"; it does not confirm the rollout began on that date.
